title: Annotation tags live in two places: the annotation.tags column and the annotation_tag join table, so tests must check both
answers: annotation tags test passes but tag filtering is wrong
how to verify annotation_tag join table in tests
body:
Get builds ItemDTO.Tags from the denormalized `annotation.tags` column. GetTags, which powers annotation tag filtering, joins the `annotation_tag` table instead. The two must stay in sync. xormRepositoryImpl.ensureTags in pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go maintains the join table on Add, update and AddMany.
If the join table drifts, assertions on items[0].Tags still pass because they read only the column. That is how the ensureTags delete bug stayed hidden.
To test tag changes, query the join table directly, as `Can update annotation with additional tags` in TestIntegrationAnnotations (xorm_store_test.go) does: sql.WithDbSession(...) with `SELECT tag.key FROM annotation_tag JOIN tag ON tag.id = annotation_tag.tag_id WHERE annotation_tag.annotation_id = ?`, then assert.ElementsMatch.
Run the tests with: go test ./pkg/services/annotations/... -count=1
applies: Changes to annotation tag write paths or annotation tag tests in pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl
